description: This Swift file defines a SwiftUI View named GlowingOpenClawIcon, which displays a glowing, animated icon with customizable size, glow intensity, and floating behavior. The icon features a pulsing glow and a centered application icon image, and reacts to scene phase changes to animate accordingly.

classes.name: GlowingOpenClawIcon
classes.description: A SwiftUI View representing a glowing, animated icon with a pulsing glow effect and floating animation.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializer for GlowingOpenClawIcon, allowing customization of size, glow intensity, and floating behavior.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The main view layout composing the glow effect and image, including animations and scene phase handling.

methods.name: updateBreatheAnimation
methods.description: Controls the breathing (pulsing) animation of the glow effect based on scene activity and floating enablement.
